Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim sink As New ExcelSink, wb As Workbook, m As Object, lo As Object, r As Variant, s As String, f As String, data As String, failure As String
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    f = folder & "\"
    data = "<list><item><n>1</n></item><item><n>2</n></item></list>"
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set sink.Book = wb
    Set sink.App = Application
    Log = ""
    WantCancel = 0
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 1
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.Import(f & "d.xml")
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 2
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = wb.XmlImportXml(data, m, True)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 3
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): r = r & " " & m.ExportXml(s)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 4
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): r = r & " " & m.Export(f & "out.xml", True)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 5
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): wb.SaveAsXMLData f & "out2.xml", m: r = r & " saved"
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 6
        WantCancel = 1
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data) & " " & lo.Range.Address
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 7
        WantCancel = 2
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): r = r & " " & m.ExportXml(s) & " " & Len(s)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 8
        WantCancel = 3
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data) & " " & lo.Range.Address
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 9
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": Application.EnableEvents = False: r = m.ImportXml(data) & " " & m.ExportXml(s)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 10
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml("<other/>")
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 11
        WantCancel = 2
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): r = r & " " & m.Export(f & "out3.xml", True) & " " & (Dir(f & "out3.xml") <> "")
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 12
        WantCancel = 2
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data): wb.SaveAsXMLData f & "out4.xml", m: r = r & " " & (Dir(f & "out4.xml") <> "")
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 13
        WantCancel = 1
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = wb.XmlImportXml(data, m, True) & " " & lo.Range.Address
        On Error GoTo 0
    Case 14
        WantCancel = 0
        Application.EnableEvents = True
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Set m = wb.XmlMaps.Add(f & "s.xsd", "list"): Set lo = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A2"), , xlYes): lo.ListColumns(1).XPath.SetValue m, "/list/item/n": r = m.ImportXml(data, False) & " " & m.ImportXml("<list/>")
        On Error GoTo 0
    End Select
    Probe = Log & "|" & CStr(r) & failure
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    failure = "!E" & Err.Number
    Resume Next
End Function
